abilities.effect: Before allocating damage to a friendly unit, you can spend any number of rage dice. For each rage dice spent, reduce your fury level by 1, to a minimum of 0, then roll a dice. On a 3+, remove 1 damage point from that unit’s damage pool.

abilities.name: ARCANE CHARGE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick a Place of Power you control to be the target.
abilities.effect: Draw a straight line from the centre of the primary objective to the target. If that line crosses any secondary objectives, the first secondary objective that the line crosses is now the primary objective and all other objectives are now secondary objectives.

abilities.name: SUMMON AETHERVOID PENDULUM
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Aethervoid Pendulum on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an Aethervoid Pendulum wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON QUICKSILVER SWORDS
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Quicksilver Swords endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Quicksilver Swords endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON CHRONOMANTIC COGS
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Chronomantic Cogs endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Chronomantic Cogs endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: SIEGE BREAKERS
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO PETRIFEX ELITE unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target’s melee weapons have Anti-WATCHTOWER (+1 Rend) for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: BODYGUARD
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly units that have not charged this turn and are wholly within 6" of your general.

abilities.name: EMERGENCY SHORING
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a Watchtower within 3" of a friendly INFANTRY unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Heal (D6) the target. That friendly INFANTRY unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: LETHISIAN FORTIFICATIONS
abilities.effect: Friendly units have WARD (6+) while they are wholly within 3" of a friendly Watchtower.

abilities.name: ESCAPE ROUTE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat and is within 3" of the escape route battlefield edge to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield. It has escaped.

abilities.name: TOUGH AS STONE
abilities.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for shooting attacks made by enemy units that target friendly PETRIFEX ELITE units that are more than 12" from them.

abilities.name: FEARLESS DEFENDERS
abilities.effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly units while they are within 3" of a secure fortification.

abilities.name: TIRELESS TREAD
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Your Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO PETRIFEX ELITE unit that is not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target can immediately use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

abilities.name: FOR LETHIS!
abilities.effect: Make 3 rally rolls of D6 for each friendly Lethis unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 12" of the unit using the 'Rally' command.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared the 'Rally' command

abilities.name: SOUND THE HORNS OF WAR
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army). Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Subtract 2 from charge rolls for friendly and enemy units for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: CONSTRUCTS OF WAR
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly HEROES that target an enemy HERO.

abilities.name: DESPERATE REINFORCEMENTS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: You can return D3 slain models to each friendly unit in combat.

abilities.name: UNSTOPPABLE FORCE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO PETRIFEX ELITE unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can use a RUN ability and still use CHARGE abilities later in the turn.

abilities.name: RALLY THE RESERVES
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to D3 friendly non-UNIQUE units that have been destroyed to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Set up replacement units more than 9" from all enemy units and either wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge in friendly territory or wholly within 3" of a secure fortification.

abilities.name: THE COLUMN MARCHES ONWARDS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to D3 friendly non-UNIQUE units that have been destroyed to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Set up replacement units more than 9" from all enemy units and either wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge in friendly territory or wholly within 3" of a seized fortification.

abilities.name: STORM THE FORTIFICATIONS
abilities.declare: Pick a secure fortification that you control to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, that fortification is no longer secure and is seized for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: WARDS AGAINST UNDEATH
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 15" of a secure fortification that has no enemy units within 3" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Both players roll 2D6. If the Lethis player’s roll is higher than the Petrifex Elite player’s roll, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the difference between the rolls.

abilities.name: BLINDING CHARGE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a unit in this Regiment of Renown that charged this turn. Then, pick an enemy INFANTRY unit within 1" of that unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target.

abilities.name: MASTERS OF ALL TERRAIN
abilities.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to run rolls and charge rolls for units in this Regiment of Renown and to their Move characteristic.

abilities.name: DAWNRIDER CHARGE
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s Dawnrider Lances and Blades if it charged in the same turn.

warscrolls.name: Vanari Lord Regent on Lightcourser

abilities.name: LEAD THE CHARGE
abilities.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for friendly LUMINETH REALM-LORDS units while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.

abilities.name: PUREST AETHERQUARTZ
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks and subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.

abilities.name: TAKTIKAL COWERING
abilities.effect:
While the Loonboss in this Regiment of Renown is within the combat range of the Dankhold Troggoth in this Regiment of Renown:
That Loonboss has WARD (4+).
Each time you make a successful ward roll for that Loonboss, allocate 1 damage point to that Dankhold Troggoth after the damage sequence for that Loonboss has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilities.name: GO DAT WAY!
abilities.declare: Pick the Dankhold Troggoth in this Regiment of Renown to be the target if it is within 12" of the Loonboss in this Regiment of Renown.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can still use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: MAGICAL RESISTANCE
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilities.effect: If this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 4+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared a SPELL ability

abilities.name: WADE AND SMASH
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: This unit can move 6" but must end that move in combat. Then, roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 1" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: REGENERATION
abilities.effect: Heal (D3) this unit.

warscrolls.name: Loonboss
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Moonclan Agitator.

abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Moonclan Stabbas unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 2+, pick 1 of the following effects:
Get Back ’Ere!: If the target is not in combat, you can return D6 slain models to it.
Stab ’Em Good!: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: LET’S GET STABBIN’!
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly non-HERO MOONCLAN INFANTRY unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit

abilities.name: SIGMAR’S GRACE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly DRACONITH SKYWING PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a friendly DRACONITH SKYWING unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Heal (D3) the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, HEAL (2D3) the target instead.

abilities.name: SANCTIFICATION
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly DRACONITH SKYWING PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy WIZARDS while they are within 30" of the chanter. If the chanting roll was 12+, subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy WIZARDS for the rest of the battle and friendly PRIESTS cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: FEARLESS FLIERS
abilities.effect: If this unit is not in combat, it can immediately make a D6" move and can end that move in combat.

abilities.name: CELESTIUM ENSIGN
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: Heal (3) each friendly DRACONITH SKYWING unit wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: AETHERIC CYCLONE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly DRACONITH SKYWING MONSTER that has not used any RAMPAGE abilities this turn to use this ability. Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: SHIELDS OF THE WARDEN
abilities.effect:
While any friendly Stormdrake Guard units are within a friendly Ionus Cryptborn’s combat range:
That friendly Ionus Cryptborn has WARD (4+).
Each time you make a successful ward roll for that friendly Ionus Cryptborn, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly Stormdrake Guard unit within its combat range after the damage sequence for that friendly Ionus Cryptborn has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilities.name: THUNDEROUS ROAR
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly DRACONITH SKYWING MONSTER that has not used any RAMPAGE abilities this turn to use this ability. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with it to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, subtract 5 from that target’s control score for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: EXEMPLARS OF FURY
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of Companion weapons used by friendly DRACONITH SKYWING HEROES while they are within 6" of 2 or more friendly Stormdrake Guard units.

abilities.name: SUMMON EVERBLAZE COMET
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Everblaze Comet on the battlefield, pick a friendly DRACONITH SKYWING WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an Everblaze Comet wholly within 18" of the caster.

abilities.name: REGAL AUTHORITY
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly DRACONITH SKYWING WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly DRACONITH SKYWING unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Add 5 to the target’s control score for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: CRUISING INTO POSITION
abilities.declare: Pick all units in this Regiment of Renown that have not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up all of those units in reserve plying the winds. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: THE GOOD SHIP AELSLING
abilities.effect: The Aelsling in this Regiment of Renown has a Health characteristic of 17 instead of 14.

abilities.name: DAREDEVIL DEPLOYMENT
abilities.declare: Pick the Arkanaut Frigate in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability if it is plying the winds.
abilities.effect: Set up the Arkanaut Frigate anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up all other units in this Regiment of Renown wholly within 6" of the Arkanaut Frigate and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: YOU CALL IT YOURS, I CALL IT MINE
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for shooting attacks made by units in this Regiment of Renown that target an enemy unit that is within 6" of an enemy unit that has an enhancement.

abilities.name: GRIZZLED BUCCANEERS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
This unit can immediately use a SHOOT ability as if it were your shooting phase but all of its attacks must target the target enemy unit.
For the rest of the phase, this unit’s Privateer Heavy Weapons have Shoot in Combat.

abilities.name: MEDIUM BOMB RACKS
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that does not have FLY and that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 6 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: INCOMING!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: ASSAULT BOAT
abilities.declare: This unit cannot use this ability if it is in combat or has used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn. Pick a number of units up to its Transport Capacity that are wholly within 6" of it, that are not in combat and that have not charged this turn to be the targets. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
This unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll and must end the move within ½" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so:
Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within this unit’s combat range. The targets can be set up in combat.
This unit and the targets have charged, and the targets cannot use another Core ability this phase.
Pick up to 1 of the targets to have STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Heavy Sky Ordnance is 3.

abilities.name: TRANSPORT CAPACITY
abilities.effect: This unit can transport up to 2 friendly KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY units with a combined model count of up to 12 (see Battle Traits).

abilities.name: CAPTAIN OF THE AELSLING
abilities.declare: Pick an Arkanaut Frigate in this unit’s regiment to be the target. This unit can use this ability while in reserve, and the target can also be in reserve.
abilities.effect: The target has the AELSLING keyword. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s Boarding Weapons for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: SHE CAN HANDLE IT!
abilities.effect: You can re-roll run rolls and charge rolls for the AELSLING while it is wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: AUXILIARY SKYHOOK
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy MONSTER in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
Subtract 1 from wound rolls made for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: NAUGHTY OR NICE?
abilities.effect:
If you are the naughty player, friendly units’ melee weapons have Crit (Auto-wound) while they are contesting Da Red Gobbo.
If you are the nice player, friendly units have WARD (6+) while they are contesting Da Red Gobbo

abilities.name: CLANK, CLANK, CLANK
abilities.effect:
Roll 3D6. If Da Red Gobbo is within a number of inches of the exit point equal to the roll, he escapes, the battle ends immediately and both players lose.
Otherwise, pick a point on the battlefield within a number of inches of Da Red Gobbo equal to the roll. That point must be as near as possible to the exit point. Remove Da Red Gobbo from the battlefield and set him up again as near as possible to that point and more than 1" from all terrain features. If you are the underdog, set him up again within 6" of that point and more than 1" from all terrain features instead.

abilities.name: MAGNIFICENT MONSTROSITY
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect. If any enemy units are contesting Da Red Gobbo, you can add or subtract 1 from the roll (to a minimum of 1).
1
…Da Green Button?: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each unit’s melee weapons (friendly and enemy) for the rest of the turn.
2
…Da Blue Button?: Each player can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll or 1 random characteristic roll for a weapon’s Damage characteristic this turn.
3
…Da Yellow Button?: Each player gains 1 command point.
4
…Da Orange Button?: Each unit (friendly and enemy) on the battlefield has a Move characteristic of 3D6" for the rest of the turn.
5
…Da Purple Button?: Units (friendly and enemy) are not visible to other units outside their combat range for the rest of the turn.
6
…Da Red Button?: You must immediately use the ‘Clank, Clank, Clank’ ability as if it were the end of your turn.
7+
…Da Whirly Button?: Pick an enemy unit within 18" of Da Red Gobbo. Remove that unit from the battlefield. Then your opponent picks a point on the battlefield. Set up that enemy unit within 1" of that point and more than 9" from all enemy units. Each model in that enemy unit that cannot be set up in this way is automatically slain.

abilities.name: THE HORNS HIT HOME
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly unit that is preparing a flank attack to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Set up the targets on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of each other, wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: WE’LL BE THERE - IF THE PAY’S RIGHT
abilities.declare: Pick each unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the targets if none of them have been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up the targets in reserve preparing a flank attack. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: RAVENOUS COUNTER-ATTACK
abilities.effect: Enemy units do not count as having charged while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: SHOCK AND GORE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks.

abilities.name: GLUTTHORN STAMPEDE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is INFANTRY. On a 4+, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Glutthorn’s Horn and Hooves is 5.

abilities.name: PITILESS WARLORD

abilities.effect: Re-roll 1 dice in that charge roll.

abilities.name: SEARCH THE RUIN
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that does not have an emberstone nugget and is contesting a Sun Seekers objective to be the target.
abilities.effect: Give the target an emberstone nugget. If you are the underdog, the target can immediately move 6" but cannot end that move in combat. The target cannot use the ‘Back to Base Camp’ or ‘Power Through’ ability for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: BACK TO BASE CAMP
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that has an emberstone nugget, was not set up this turn and is contesting a Golden Lions objective to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target’s emberstone nugget.

abilities.name: CORVEN LORD
abilities.effect: If this unit has the ’Ruination Chamber’, ability, it can use that ability once per turn regardless of whether another friendly unit has used it during the same turn.

abilities.name: HALLOWED SCROLLS
abilities.effect: If this unit is INFANTRY, it has WARD (5+). Otherwise, it has WARD (6+).

abilities.name: RAVEN’S FLIGHT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly RUINATION BROTHERHOOD PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the turn. If the chanting roll was 8+, in addition, for the rest of the turn, the target can use CHARGE abilities even if they have used a RUN ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: MURDEROUS FLOCK
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly RUINATION BROTHERHOOD PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target unit. If the chanting roll was 10+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target unit for each 4+ instead.

abilities.name: MORRDA’S EMBRACE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly RUINATION BROTHERHOOD PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain. If the chanting roll was 10+, roll 2D6 instead.

abilities.name: ENTROPIC SCREECH
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly RUINATION CHAMBER MONSTER that has not used any RAMPAGE abilities this turn to use this ability. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with it to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. The unit using this ability cannot use any more RAMPAGE abilities for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: TEMPER THE FLAW
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: You must use this ability at the end of each turn. Each friendly non-HERO RUINATION CHAMBER unit that used a FIGHT ability this turn is a target.
abilities.effect:
For each target, pick 1 of the following effects:
Guided: If the target is wholly within 12" of any friendly RUINATION CHAMBER HEROES, return 1 slain model to it.
Tormented: If the target is not wholly within 12" of any friendly RUINATIONS CHAMBER HEROES, it becomes tormented until the end of the next turn. While a unit is tormented, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons but it cannot contest objectives or use commands.

abilities.name: ANCIENT AURA
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army) Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly RUINATION CHAMBER unit.
abilities.effect: That unit has WARD (5+) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: HALLOWED PRESENCE
abilities.effect: While friendly non-WARRIOR CHAMBER units are wholly within 12" of any friendly RUINATION CHAMBER units, those friendly WARRIOR CHAMBER units have WARD (6+).

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly VANGUARD CHAMBER unit that did not use a MOVE ability this turn and is not in combat.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON SOULSNARE SHACKLES
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulsnare Shackles endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Soulsnare Shackles endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulsnare Shackles endless spell has 3 parts that must each be set up within 3" of at least 1 other part.

abilities.name: SUMMON MALEVOLENT MAELSTROM
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Malevolent Maelstrom on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Malevolent Maelstrom wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON SUFFOCATING GRAVETIDE
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Suffocating Gravetide on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Suffocating Gravetide wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON PURPLE SUN OF SHYISH
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Purple Sun of Shyish on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Purple Sun of Shyish wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: DEVASTATING COLLAPSE
abilities.effect: When the unit in this Regiment of Renown is destroyed, before removing it from play, you and your opponent must roll off. If you roll higher, inflict 3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within its combat range.

abilities.name: JUMP UP AND DOWN
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If the unit in this Regiment of Renown charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. Add 1 to each roll if the target is contesting an objective you do not control. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, if any of the rolls were an unmodified 1, resolve the effect of the Devastating Collapse’ ability as if the unit in this Regiment of Renown had been destroyed (it is neither destroyed nor removed from play).

abilities.name: BET YOU CAN’T...
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly Mancrusher Gargant on the battlefield to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
...Kill the Big Eads: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target’s melee weapons while they are in combat with any enemy HEROES or MONSTERS.
...Get There Before Me!: Up to 3 of the targets can each use the Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
...Grab That!: Add 5 to each target’s control score for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: EXCITABLE FOLLOWERS
abilities.effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of a visible friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT HERO, this unit can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: SHOCK AND AWE
abilities.effect:
Each time this unit is set up using the ’Scions of the Storm’ ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit for the rest of the battle round.
In addition, each time a friendly STORMCAST ETERNALS unit is set up wholly within 12" of this unit using the ’Scions of the Storm’ ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit for the rest of the battle round.

abilities.name: ENVOY OF THE HEAVENS
abilities.declare: If a friendly STORMCAST ETERNALS unit was destroyed in the previous turn, pick a visible friendly STORMCAST ETERNALS unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target has WARD (5+) until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: STAUNCH DEFENDER
abilities.effect: While this unit is contesting an objective in friendly territory, add 3 to the control scores of all friendly STORMCAST ETERNALS units contesting that objective.

abilities.name: SUMMON EVERBLAZE COMET

abilities.effect: Set up an Everblaze Comet wholly within 18" of the caster.

abilities.name: SUMMON CELESTIAN VORTEX
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Celestian Vortex on the battlefield, pick a friendly STORMCAST ETERNALS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Celestian Vortex wholly within 18" of the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON DAIS ARCANUM
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Dais Arcanum on the battlefield, pick a friendly STORMCAST ETERNALS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a friendly STORMCAST ETERNALS INFANTRY HERO that does not have FLY and is wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Dais Arcanum within ½" of the target, visible to the caster and not in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and place it on the platform of that Dais Arcanum.

abilities.name: UNSTOPPABLE BATTLE FURY
abilities.effect: This unit can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: ‘I’LL GET THERE MYSELF!’
abilities.effect: This unit cannot be set up in reserve and cannot be targeted by abilities that would remove it from the battlefield.

abilities.name: GOSSAMID CHAMPION
abilities.declare: Pick the Arch-Revenant in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability, the pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract X from charge rolls for the target, where X is the number of damage points allocated to the target this phase by shooting attacks made by the Gossamid Archers unit in the Regiment of Renown, to a maximum of 6.

abilities.name: FLIGHT OF THE ZEPHYRSPITES
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.effect: If both units in this Regiment of Renown are within each other’s combat range and neither unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, remove both units from the battlefield, then set them up again within each other’s combat range, wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscrolls.name: Arch-Revenant
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Forest Sentinel.

abilities.name: FIGHT AND FLY
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this turn, this unit can move up to 2D6" after that FIGHT ability has been resolved. It cannot end that move in combat.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit

abilities.name: GOSSAMID COMMANDER
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible friendly Gossamid Archers unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target can immediately use a SHOOT ability as if it were your shooting phase but all of the attacks made as part of that SHOOT ability must target an enemy unit that is in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: ZEPHYRSPITES
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit
abilities.effect: After that SHOOT ability has been resolved, this unit can move up to D6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit

abilities.name: FOREST FIGHTERS
abilities.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

abilities.name: ANCIENT AURA
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly RUINATION CHAMBER unit.
abilities.effect: That unit has WARD (5+) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: DETERMINED DEFENDERS
abilities.effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly units while they are wholly outside enemy territory.

abilities.name: SECURE THE GATEWAY
abilities.effect: While you control the Place of Power wholly within friendly territory, friendly units’ melee weapons have Anti-charge (+1 Rend) while they are contesting an objective you control.

abilities.name: SIGMAR’S JUSTICE
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit to be marked for justice. You can pick a unit that is in reserve.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by units in this Regiment of Renown that target a unit that is marked for justice.

abilities.name: DUTY BOUND
abilities.effect: While every model in the same unit in the Regiment of Renown is contesting the same objective, add 1 to save rolls and ward rolls for that unit.

warscrolls.name: Toll’s Companions
notes: This unit can only be taken in Callis and Toll’s regiment.

abilities.name: HIDDEN AGENTS
abilities.declare: Pick this unit and a friendly Callis and Toll unit if those units have not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve in the shadows. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: SAVIOURS OF CINDERFALL
abilities.effect: While a friendly Callis and Toll unit is within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and that friendly unit have WARD (5+).

abilities.name: EMERGE FROM THE SHADOWS
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it is in the shadows.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield more than 6" from the enemy mark and more than 9" from all other enemy units. Then, set up the friendly Callis and Toll unit in the shadows wholly within 6" of this unit, more than 6" from the enemy mark and more than 9" from all other enemy units.

abilities.name: RELENTLESS HUNTERS
abilities.declare: This unit can use this ability even if it is in the shadows. If there is no enemy mark, pick an enemy HERO on the battlefield to be the target. If there are no enemy HEROES on the battlefield, pick an enemy non-HERO unit on the battlefield to be the target instead.
abilities.effect: The target is the mark for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: RIGHT TOOLS FOR THE JOB
abilities.effect: Double the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for attacks that target the enemy mark.

abilities.name: UNCAGED LIGHTNING
abilities.effect: Each time an enemy unit in combat with this unit moves or is removed from the battlefield, after that ability has been resolved, if that enemy unit is on the battlefield and not in combat with this unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Grudgesettlers
abilities.effect: Each unit in this Regiment of Renown starts the battle with 1 grudge mark. If a unit in this Regiment of Renown destroys an enemy unit, you must remove the grudge mark from that friendly unit.

abilities.name: Rune of Stoicism
abilities.declare: Pick the Runewright in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, units in this Regiment of Renown have Ward (6+) while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

warscrolls.name: Runewright
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Kromdron Noble.

abilities.name: Grudgement of the Forge
abilities.effect: Add 1 to unbinding rolls, banishment rolls and rhythmic hammering rolls for this unit while it has any grudge marks.

abilities.name: Settled with a Bullet
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit's shooting attacks while it has any grudge marks.

abilities.name: Thrundok Hail
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's shooting attacks to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is Cavalry or has Fly. Add 2 to the roll instead if the target is a Monster. On a 4+, halve the target's Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Oathkeeper Apprentice Runestriker
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's shooting attacks to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects:
Rune of Sundering: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target's melee weapons.
Rune of Burning: For the rest of the turn, combat attacks that target that enemy unit score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.
Rune of Shock: The target has Strike-last until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Artillerist's Revenge
abilities.effect: This unit's ranged weapons have Crit (2 Hits) while it has any grudge marks.

abilities.name: Tough as Stone
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for combat attacks that target this unit while every model in this unit is within 3" of an objective you control.

abilities.name: Remember Their Names
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit's attacks while it has any grudge marks.

abilities.name: SEARCHING FOR REMEDIES
abilities.effect: Remove each unit in this Regiment of Renown from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 6" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SOOTHING PULSE
abilities.declare: Pick the Branchwych in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Heal (3) the target.

abilities.name: PAIN-INDUCED FRENZY
abilities.effect: This unit’s melee weapons have Crit (2 Hits) if it charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: LATCHING PARASPITES
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target has the INFESTED keyword for the rest of the battle. INFESTED enemy units cannot move more than 6" when using non-CHARGE MOVE abilities.

warscrolls.name: Branchwych
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Forest Sentinel.

abilities.name: SLAY THE TRESPASSERS!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that is within the creeping overgrowth or that is visible to this unit and within friendly territory to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: SPREADING WARPFIRE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: If there are no flaming terrain features on the battlefield, pick a non-FACTION TERRAIN terrain feature to be the target. Otherwise, pick a non-FACTION TERRAIN terrain feature that is not flaming and that is within 12" of a flaming terrain feature to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target is flaming for the rest of the battle. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 6" of any flaming terrain features.

abilities.name: NAVIGATE THE TUNNELS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 6" of a terrain feature that has a hidden passage token to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of a different terrain feature that has a hidden passage token and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SHIFTING PASSAGES
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick 2 non-FACTION TERRAIN terrain features to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Remove all hidden passage tokens from the battlefield (if any). Then, give each target a hidden passage token.

abilities.name: ECHOES OF BLIGHT CITY
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick an objective to be the target.
abilities.effect: Inflict an amount of mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) contesting the target equal to the Instability level. Then, reset the Instability level to 1.

abilities.name: ONCOMING STORM
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly EXTREMIS CHAMBER unit that charged this turn.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, that unit has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: REDEPLOY
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Each model in that unit can move up to D6". That move cannot pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.

abilities.name: AT THE DOUBLE
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a RUN ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that RUN ability.
Do not make a run roll as part of that RUN ability. Instead, add 6" to that unit’s Move characteristic to determine the distance each model in that unit can move as part of that RUN ability.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a RUN ability

abilities.name: ALL-OUT ATTACK
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared an ATTACK ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that ATTACK ability.
Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made as part of that ATTACK ability. This also affects weapons that have the Companion weapon ability. For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from save rolls for the unit using this ability.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared an ATTACK ability

abilities.name: FORWARD TO VICTORY
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that CHARGE ability.
You can re-roll the charge roll.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a CHARGE ability

abilities.name: COUNTER-CHARGE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That unit can use a CHARGE ability as if it were your charge phase.

abilities.name: GUARDED HERO
abilities.effect:
If this HERO(not MONSTER or WAR MACHINES) is within the combat range of a friendly unit that is not a HERO:
Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this HERO.
If this HERO is INFANTRY, they cannot be picked as the target of shooting attacks made by models more than 12" from them.

abilities.name: CHAMPION
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by champions in this unit. If this unit is a BEAST, this ability affects this unit’s Companion weapons.

abilities.name: DEPLOY FACTION TERRAIN
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly faction terrain feature that has not been deployed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up the target faction terrain feature wholly within friendly territory, more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features. After you have done so, it has been deployed.

abilities.name: DEPLOY REGIMENT
abilities.declare: Pick a regiment from your army roster to be the target. No units in that regiment can have already been deployed.
abilities.effect: Keep using DEPLOY abilities without alternating until all units in that regiment have been deployed. You cannot set up units that are not in that regiment on the battlefield or in reserve as part of any of those Deploy abilities.

abilities.name: DEPLOY UNIT
abilities.declare: Pick a unit from your army roster that has not been deployed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up the target unit wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from enemy territory. After you have done so, it has been deployed.

abilities.name: ALL-OUT DEFENCE
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: A unit targeted by that ATTACK ability.
Add 1 to save rolls for that unit until that ATTACK ability has been resolved.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability

abilities.name: SHOOT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that has not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick one or more enemy units as the target(s) of that unit’s attacks (see 16.0).
abilities.effect: Resolve shooting attacks against the target unit(s).

abilities.name: CHARGE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat and has not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn to use this ability. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: That unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so, the unit using this ability has charged.

abilities.name: FIGHT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat or that charged this turn to use this ability. That unit can make a pile-in move (see 15.3). Then, if that unit is in combat, you must pick one or more enemy units as the target(s) of that unit’s attacks (see 16.0).
abilities.effect: Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s).

abilities.name: NORMAL MOVE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. That unit cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: RUN
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Make a run roll of D6. That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic added to the run roll. That unit cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: RETREAT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit. That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units but cannot end that move within an enemy unit’s combat range.

abilities.name: MAGICAL INTERVENTION
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD or PRIEST to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That friendly unit can use a SPELL, PRAYER or BANISH ability (as appropriate) as if it were your hero phase. If you do so, subtract 1 from casting rolls or chanting rolls made as part of that ability.

abilities.name: RALLY
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect:
Make 6 rally rolls of D6. For each 4+, you receive 1 rally point. Rally points can be spent in the following ways:
For each rally point spent, Heal (1) that unit.
You can spend a number of rally points equal to the Health characteristic of that unit to return a slain model to that unit.
You can spend the rally points in any combination of the above. Unspent rally points are then lost.

abilities.name: STANDARD BEARER
abilities.effect: While this unit contains any standard bearers, add 1 to this unit’s control score.

abilities.name: FLY
abilities.effect: As this unit moves, it ignores other models, terrain features and the combat ranges of enemy units. It cannot end its move in combat unless specified in the ability that allowed it to move. Ignore any vertical distance moved for this unit.

abilities.name: WARD SAVE
abilities.effect: In step 1 of the damage sequence (see 18.0), make a ward roll of D6 for each damage point in this unit’s damage pool. If the roll equals or exceeds this unit’s ward value, remove that damage point from the damage pool.

abilities.name: BANISH MANIFESTATION
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD or PRIEST to use this ability, pick a MANIFESTATION within 30" of them that was not summoned this turn to be the target, then make a banishment roll of 2D6. Add 1 to the banishment roll for each additional enemy MANIFESTATION on the battlefield after the first. You cannot pick the same MANIFESTATION to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
abilities.effect: If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on the MANIFESTATION’s warscroll, it is banished and removed from play.

abilities.name: SACRED RITES
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly PRIEST to use this ability, then make a chanting roll of D6. On an unmodified chanting roll of 1, remove 1 ritual point from that PRIEST instead of D3.
abilities.effect: Give a number to ritual points to the PRIEST equal to the unmodified chanting roll and do not reset the PRIEST’s ritual points to 0.

abilities.name: POWER THROUGH
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then you must pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. The target must have a lower Health characteristic than the unit using this ability.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, the unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through and end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units that were in combat with it at the start of the move, but not those of other enemy units. It does not have to end the move in combat.

abilities.name: MUSICIAN
abilities.effect: While this unit contains any musicians, if it uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make one additional rally roll of D6.

abilities.name: UNBIND
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: A friendly WIZARD within 30" of the enemy WIZARD casting the spell.
Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, then the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved. This reaction cannot be used more than once per casting roll.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared a SPELL ability

abilities.name: COVERING FIRE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that did not use a RUN ability this turn and that is not in combat to use this ability, then pick the closest enemy unit (to that unit) that can be picked as the target of shooting attacks to be the target. You cannot pick MANIFESTATIONS or faction terrain features as the target of this ability.
abilities.effect: Resolve shooting attacks for the unit using this ability against the target. You must subtract 1 from the hit rolls for those attacks.

abilities.name: ACTIVATE PLACE OF POWER
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly HERO within 3" of any Places of Power to use this ability.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on that HERO. On a 2+, pick 1 of the following effects:
Ignite Fury: Gain 2 rage dice, then increase your fury level by 2, to a maximum of 7.
Channel Wrath: If that HERO is a WIZARD or PRIEST, add 1 to casting rolls or chanting rolls for that HERO for the rest of the turn.
Dizzying Rage: For the rest of the turn, if that HERO is not a WIZARD or PRIEST, they can use the ’Unbind’ or ’Banish Manifestation’ ability as if they had WIZARD (1).

abilities.name: TRAVEL THE NIDUS PATHS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of a Nidus Path to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of the linked Nidus Path in the opposite corner of the battlefield, more than 9" from all enemy units.
When the underdog uses this ability, they can choose to set up the target wholly within 12" of any Nidus Path and more than 9" from all enemy units instead of the linked Nidus Path in the opposite corner of the battlefield.

abilities.name: ESCAPE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 6" of the escape point in enemy territory to use this ability, then pick an objective it is contesting to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target objective and the unit using this ability from the battlefield. That unit has escaped.

abilities.name: GRAB THE REALMSTONE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability, then pick an objective it is contesting, that you control and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target objective from the battlefield and set it up again within 3" of the unit using this ability and not on a terrain feature.

abilities.name: THE RITUAL
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 3" of the Mother Cauldron to be the target. Then, roll a dice.
abilities.effect: On a 1, the Mother Cauldron is destroyed. On a 2+, the target is destroyed.

abilities.name: SECURE NEW GROUND
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for friendly units’ combat attacks while they contest an objective that you do not control.

abilities.name: RESERVE CONTINGENT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit in the second turn force or the third turn force that has not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up that unit in reserve. It has now been deployed.

abilities.name: ARRIVAL OF RESERVES
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit in reserve.
abilities.effect: Set up that unit anywhere wholly within friendly territory more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: BACKBONE OF SUCCESS
abilities.effect: While a non-HERO unit is contesting an objective, HEROES contesting that objective have a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: SEISMIC SHIFT
abilities.effect: Remove 1 objective from the battlefield.

abilities.name: TOP OF THE FOOD CHAIN
abilities.declare: Pick 3 friendly units to bе the targets.
abilities.effect: Each target has the PREDATOR keyword for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: THE RITUAL
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Battle Round
abilities.effect:
Gain D6 ritual points if you control the Ritual Site.
Gain D3 ritual points for each Arcane Repository you control.
Lose D3 ritual points for each Arcane Repository that you do not control.

abilities.name: SLAIN ON THE PLACE OF POWER
abilities.effect: Each time an enemy HERO that is contesting an objective is slain by a combat attack made by a friendly HERO, add the Control characteristic of that slain HERO to the control score of that friendly HERO for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: MIRRORSHIELD
abilities.effect: This unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks unless the attacking model is within 9" of it.

abilities.name: QUICKSILVER DRAUGHT
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: This unit has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: NULL PENDANT
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Subtract 5 from the target’s control score for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: TOE TO TOE
abilities.effect: Subtract 10 from the control scores of enemy MONSTERS while they are in combat with any units in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: GRIMNIR’S DEFIANCE
abilities.effect: Units in this Regiment of Renown cannot be picked to be the target of RAMPAGE abilities used by enemy units.

abilities.name: DUTY UNTO DEATH
abilities.effect: While any friendly FYRESLAYERS INFANTRY HEROES are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have WARD (5+).

abilities.name: SMOULDERING BRAZIERS
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: WHIRLWIND OF DESTRUCTION
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons if this unit charged this turn.

warscrolls.name: Grimhold Exile
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as Grimnir’s Chosen.

abilities.name: LAST OF THE LODGE-FIRE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target’s Health characteristic. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: HONOUR TO GRIMNIR!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly FYRESLAYERS INFANTRY units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for the targets for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: MOLTEN ROCKBOLTS
abilities.effect: Each time a shooting attack made by this unit scores a critical hit, subtract 1" from the target unit’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn. This ability cannot reduce the target unit’s unmodified Move characteristic below half.

abilities.name: SUMMON BURNING HEAD
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly The Burning Head on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up The Burning Head wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON EMERALD LIFESWARM
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Emerald Lifeswarm on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an Emerald Lifeswarm wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON RAVENAK’S GNASHING JAWS
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Ravenak’s Gnashing Jaws endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Ravenak’s Gnashing Jaws endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: HUNT OF THE BLOODTHIRSTY SHIVER
abilities.effect:
If both units in this Regiment of Renown are within each other’s combat range, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:
Evasive Approach: While both units in this Regiment of Renown are within each other’s combat range, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target them.
Ferocious Attack: While both units in this Regiment of Renown are within each other’s combat range, their Allopex’s Ferocious Bites have Crit (2 Hits).

abilities.name: ENSNARED
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy MONSTER or CAVALRY unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

abilities.name: BLOODTHIRSTY PREDATORS
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Allopex’s Ferocious Bite while it is within 6" of any damaged enemy units or while it is within 6" of any enemy units that had any models slain in the same turn.

abilities.name: TREAD CAREFULLY
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of First Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick an objective within friendly territory to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target is no longer stable.

abilities.name: VIOLENT TREMOR
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick a pair of objectives to be the targets.
abilities.effect: The stable target objective is no longer stable. The other target objective is stable instead.

abilities.name: RUNE OF RESTORED HEARTH
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase

abilities.name: CONCEALED IN THE SHADOWS
abilities.effect: While they are wholly within 3" of a terrain feature, the Spite-Revenants units in this Regiment of Renown are not visible to enemy units more than 12" away from them.

abilities.name: ENRAGE THE SPITES
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units that are visible to and within 12" of this unit or that are within the creeping overgrowth to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.

abilities.name: TERROR OF THE DEEP WOODS

abilities.effect: You can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within ½" of an enemy unit and wholly within X" of a terrain feature that has a friendly overgrown token, where X is equal to the charge roll. If you do so, this unit has charged.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is wholly within the creeping overgrowth, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, add 1 to charge rolls for this unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: ROLLING ASH-CLOUDS

abilities.name: FIERCE COMPETITION

Each time a unit in this Regiment of Renown uses an ability and any enemy models were slain by that ability, after that ability has been resolved, the unit that used that ability is pre-eminent and the other unit in this Regiment of Renown is overlooked.
Weapons used by an overlooked unit in this Regiment of Renown have Crit (Auto-wound).

abilities.effect: After that SHOOT ability has been resolved, this unit can move 2D6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 12". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat. abilities.name: SYNCHRONISED STRIKES
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly WARRIOR CHAMBER units while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly NON-HERO NON-BEAST STORMCAST ETERNALS units that do not have the WARRIOR CHAMBER keyword.

abilities.name: EMBERSTONE CACHE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit contesting an objective you control to be the target.
abilities.effect: Give the target an emberstone sliver.

abilities.name: EMBERSTONE-AUGMENTED WEAPONS
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that charged this turn and has any emberstone slivers to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:
Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
Then, if you are the underdog, remove all of the target’s emberstone slivers. Otherwise, remove all emberstone slivers from each friendly unit.

abilities.name: SUMMON KRONDSPINE INCARNATE OF GHUR
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect:
While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
The Attacks characteristic of its Crushing Iron Feet is 3.
It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: MERCENARY ATTITUDES
abilities.declare: Pick another friendly non-UNIQUE unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn and while the target is wholly within 12" of this unit:
You can re-roll run rolls for the target.
Add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
The target cannot be targeted by shooting attacks.
Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
Add 10 to the target’s control score.

abilities.name: Itinerant Grimmdron
abilities.effect: If the Grimhold Exile in this Regiment of Renown has used the 'Wrathful Wanderer' ability this battle, remove the other units in this Regiment of Renown from the battlefield and set them up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge, wholly within 6" of the Grimhold Exile in this Regiment of Renown and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, give a unit in this Regiment of Renown 1 grudge mark.

abilities.name: Fury of Grimnir
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Movement Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit has any grudge marks and is not in combat, it can move D6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat and cannot end that move any further from the closest enemy unit.

abilities.name: Duty unto Death
abilities.effect: While any friendly Grimmdron Infantry Heroes are wholly within this unit's combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have Ward (5+).

warscrolls.name: Grimhold Exile
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as Grimnir’s Chosen.

abilities.name: Alone but Never Outnumbered
abilities.effect: This unit has Strike-first while there are no other friendly units within 6" of it.

abilities.name: Wrathful Wanderer
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield, then set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Relentless Wrath
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Movement Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit has any grudge marks and is not in combat, it can move D6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat and cannot end that move any further from the closest enemy unit.

warscrolls.name: Auric Flamekeeper
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as Grimnir’s Chosen.

abilities.name: Masterflame Rune
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Grimmdron Infantry unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a Masterflame rune roll by rolling a dice.
abilities.effect:
On a 1, or if the roll is equal to or less than the number of friendly Khazalite Holds units that have been destroyed during the battle, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:
Grimnir's Grit: The target has Ward (5+).
Grimnir's Resolve: You can re-roll charge rolls for the target.
Grimnir's Vengeance: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target's melee weapons.

abilities.name: Relight the Fire
abilities.effect: If this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, give each visible friendly Grimmdron unit within 6" of it 1 grudge mark.

abilities.name: Fire-fuelled Anger
abilities.effect: Subtract 2 from Masterflame rune rolls for this unit while it has any grudge marks.
